description: Covalent (now also branded GoldRush) provides a unified REST API that indexes blockchain data across many networks so developers can query balances, transactions, token transfers, NFTs, and historical prices without running their own nodes. Typical usage is authenticated API-key requests against a versioned HTTPS base URL for wallet portfolio, activity, and token metadata endpoints.
